quote: I removed the preview and thought it done. But V8 quotes an excerpt of the offending input INSIDE

quote: A MAC failure cannot distinguish slot replacement from MAC-only corruption.

quote: the `LockTicket` brand's OPTIONAL property was vacuous (a bare `symbol` still assigned; the documented compile-time guarantee was false)

text: - **P1, the first release after the tools extraction** (from [tools-extraction](tools-extraction/plan.md), 2026-09-28). The next `release: promote dev → main` carries the tools removal, #711 and #713 to `main`, and with them the first production build of `nulo-landing` from `main` with the routes-free config. After `attach-assets`, re-run that build in the Cloudflare dashboard, confirm it succeeded, and check that `curl -s https://nulo.sh` links `releases/tag/v<version>` and that `curl -sI` returns every header in `apps/landing/public/_headers`. Delete this entry when it passes.

- **The gas link and USDC on mainnet** (owner UI calls, 2026-09-28). The fee card's get-gas link opens unleashed's testnet app on every network, on its `workers.dev` host; the mainnet USDC seed is the retired bridge's token. Revisit when unleashed has its own domain or a public mainnet bridge.

- **The execution layer's selector refusals interpolate the call.** Six throws start `Scope violation:` and carry the call's name, the ABI function and the target (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/execution/tx-request-builder.ts:346`, `:595`, `fast-path.ts:139`, `view-executor.ts:372`, `service.ts:1049`, `authwit-discoverer.ts:203`). They run after the grant check, while the wallet builds, simulates or signs, some with no window (a simulation or a utility call), so they reach the executors' failed records and whatever logs the error there: they need their own sink inventory. From [dapp-grants](dapp-grants/plan.md), F-1.

- **Every other failure before a dApp send is claimed reads "Popup closed early".** `failQueuedForError` files anything but a scope refusal as `popup_bound` (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/wallet-sdk/queued-journal.ts:273`, from `background.ts:1228`), and so does the ended-session path (`background.ts:1183`): a Terms refusal, a missing capability, a malformed request. Their honest labels are a copy decision, and the Terms case is next in line (2026-09-29, decided under the owner's delegation). From [dapp-grants](dapp-grants/plan.md), F-2.

- **A dApp that cannot read the accounts can test whether an address is in the session**, through any scoped call's success versus refusal: with a contracts grant, `isTokenRegistered(token, { scopes: [candidate] })` answers a member and refuses anyone else, with no window (`packages/wallet-bridge/src/method-descriptors.ts:157`, `scope-enforcement.ts:67-86`, `dispatcher.ts:904`; `apps/extension/src/wallet/services/wallet-sdk/background.ts:203-208`), and `simulateTx` with `opts.from` or `scopes` does the same. Closing it is a design choice (for example, without `canGet` a named account is refused whether or not it is a member), for its own plan. From [dapp-grants](dapp-grants/plan.md), F-3.

- **A dApp cannot widen a contract-classes grant.** Coverage is type-only (`packages/wallet-bridge/src/dispatcher.ts:719-720`), so a wider request opens no window unless the type was rejected before (`:514`). The answer shows the held classes, truthfully, but the dApp has no way to ask for more; a field-aware coverage rule is a product change for its own plan. From [dapp-grants](dapp-grants/plan.md), F-4.

- **Repeated scope refusals pile up in Activity.** Every scope-refused send leaves one failed row, which the GC never evicts (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/operation-journal/gc.ts:17-24`, `:127-130`), and the per-session cap of 8 counts only `queued` rows (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/wallet-sdk/queued-journal.ts:37`, `:176-187`), so a connected app that retries a refused send adds one card per try, with no limit. Cap or merge repeated refusals per session; on the 2026-09-29 panel, codex would have blocked the sign-off on it. From [dapp-grants](dapp-grants/plan.md), F-5.

- **`shotSend` takes its second theme mid-transition.** It flips the theme and shoots at once (`apps/extension/tests/e2e/fixtures/send-page.ts:224-230`), while `PopupCard` and `Button` transition their colours over 0.2 s, so a sheet's or a button's flipped capture reads washed out or dimmed. Wait for the flip's transitions to end before the second shot; until then, read sheets and buttons in the first theme. From [send-amount-exact](send-amount-exact/plan.md), F-4.

- **The unit switch, Max and Refresh quote are mouse-only.** Each is a `<span @click>` with no role, `tabindex` or key handler (`apps/extension/src/components/composite/send/AmountCard.vue:412-422`, `:442`; `apps/extension/src/popup/pages/send.vue:717`), so the keyboard cannot reach or press them; CLAUDE.md § Keyboard & focus order asks for `tabindex="0"`, Enter and Space. Where they sit in the Tab order is an owner call. From [send-amount-exact](send-amount-exact/plan.md), F-5.

- **A press on Max while the destination holds the focus is lost.** The press's `mousedown` blurs the destination, which turns into the account's card (`apps/extension/src/popup/components/modules/send/RecipientField.vue:53-61`) 22 px taller, so Max moves before `mouseup`, the `click` lands on a common ancestor and Max never runs; a second press works. On dev too. Keeping the card's height or acting on `pointerdown` changes the page or the press: an owner call. From [send-amount-exact](send-amount-exact/plan.md), F-6.

- **In USD mode a long derived amount wraps the line under the field.** The derived token amount (`derivedTokenLabel` in `apps/extension/src/components/composite/send/AmountCard.vue`, every decimal) shares a line with the balance, and at a price that is not round an everyday dollar amount derives 18 decimals ("≈ 100.014302045192462522 TST" for $100 at $0.999857), so beside a large balance the line breaks over three rows, "≈" alone on the first. On dev too. In USD mode after Max (`p12-usd-max`, both browsers) the long word also pushes MAX past the popup's gutter, cut at its right edge, from token-mode Max then the switch as from USD-mode Max. Shrinking, cutting or moving the derived amount is an owner call. From [send-amount-exact](send-amount-exact/plan.md), F-7.

- **At rest the USD field hides its tail.** It keeps 40 px and no grouping, so after Max it shows "1235567.1234" of 1,235,567.123457, where the token field shows every digit. On dev too. An owner call. From [send-amount-exact](send-amount-exact/plan.md), F-8.

- **A wrapped review line indents its symbol 4 px.** The symbol's `margin-left` moves onto the second line with it (`.amount small` in `apps/extension/src/popup/components/modules/send/SendReviewSheet.vue`); a gap on the number's end would fix it. Cosmetic, and only on a wrapped line, which takes a billion-plus 18-decimal amount. From [send-amount-exact](send-amount-exact/plan.md), F-9.

- **The fiat notice can say the price moved when it did not.** Its text depends only on whether a live quote exists (`apps/extension/src/popup/pages/send.vue:715`), so a session frozen 15 minutes ago at an unmoved price (the gate's `stale-snapshot`) reads "The price moved since you started typing."; a stale-snapshot wording is a copy call. On dev too. From [send-amount-exact](send-amount-exact/plan.md), F-10.

- **The address-keyed fee maps outlive a deleted profile off the live path.** `nulo:ui:feePaymentMethods` and `nulo:ui:sendFeePaymentMethods` hold `{ [address]: … }` (`apps/extension/src/popup/components/modules/send/FeeSettingsCard.vue:334-337`, and `withSendSlot` in `fee-send-selection.ts` beside it). Only the reset page removes them (`apps/extension/src/popup/pages/settings/security/reset.vue:85-87`), after the live delete returns, so the resume and torn-reap paths, and a popup closed mid-delete, keep the deleted profile's addresses. Pruning by address is unsafe, since two profiles can share one, and moving the global wipe onto the other paths changes their behaviour: it needs its own decision. From [wallet-safety-fixes](wallet-safety-fixes/plan.md), F-1.

- **An Allow the watchdog displaced mid-un-hide leaves receipts hidden under `trusted`.** After a stall of five minutes or more inside the lock, a displaced Allow with no Block after it stops un-hiding, and only `setTrustAllow` writes `hidden: false` (`unhideLocked`, `apps/extension/src/wallet/services/incoming-transfer/service.ts:660-676`), so nothing un-hides the rest. The owner signed the state off as a residual; a `(BUG PIN)` in `service.scenarios.test.ts` holds it. Candidates: re-run the un-hide on replay, or un-hide before the trust write, which needs a `pending` trust row first because the floor skips a contract with none (`:866`). From [wallet-safety-fixes](wallet-safety-fixes/plan.md), F-4.

- **A pin or a token-deletion cleanup racing a profile deletion can recreate its pinned-tokens key** (residual R1, signed off by the owner). The purge removes `nulo:ui:pinnedTokens@<id>` on every deletion path, but a popup that has not yet seen the deletion can write it again (`pin` and `onTokenDeleted`, `apps/extension/src/composables/usePinnedTokens.ts:214-243`). A restore that reuses the id then shows those pins (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/profile/service.ts:1526-1529` frees the id; `operation-journal/service.ts:273-274` says why ids come back); otherwise the key stays as an orphan. Fixes: fence the key by incarnation, or a sweep cheaper than reading the whole store at every background start. From [wallet-safety-fixes](wallet-safety-fixes/plan.md), F-5.

- **Two of the token add's compensations delete by id without lock ownership.** `persistToken`'s post-set deletion and network checks (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/token/service.ts:419-431`) delete `token.id` even when the lock's watchdog displaced the add, so a same-id restore's row can go with it; the last check before `onTokenAdded` deletes only while the add owns the lock. At those two points the row may postdate the purge's snapshot, so skipping the delete can orphan it: the choice needs its own decision. From [wallet-safety-fixes](wallet-safety-fixes/plan.md), F-7.

- **Recovery phrase and Change password have no submit latch.** A mouse double-click on Retrieve runs `handleUnlock` twice (`apps/extension/src/popup/pages/settings/security/export/seed.vue:55-67`), and the second `countdown.start()` leaves a 5-minute close that "keep open" cannot cancel (`apps/extension/src/composables/useSecretCountdown.ts:26-35`). Change Password is disabled while loading (`apps/extension/src/popup/pages/settings/security/change-password.vue:228`), so only a same-tick double click reaches it twice. `seed.vue` also has no unmount fence (`full.vue`'s `generation` is the pattern), so a Retrieve that resolves after the page left sets the phrase on the dead page and arms that timer. Since both buttons refuse a repeat Enter, only a pointer reaches either twice. From [keyboard-guards](keyboard-guards/plan.md), FU-1.

- **Two keyboard focus rings do not show.** The sub-page back arrow is a bare `<button>` (`packages/design/src/ui/SubPageHeaderBase.vue:36-45`) under the base stylesheet's `button { outline: none; }` (`packages/design/src/base.css:270-275`), on every page built on `SubPageHeader` or `CollapsingHeroLayout`, and onboarding's active method tab draws its `:focus-visible` outline in `--nulo-accent` over a fill of the same colour (`apps/extension/src/onboarding/pages/create.vue:253-261`). A keyboard user cannot see that focus is on Back. Drawing a ring changes how those screens look, so it is the owner's call. From [keyboard-guards](keyboard-guards/plan.md), FU-3.

- **Send's token card has no focus style of its own.** It is a `role="button"` row with `tabindex="0"` and no `:focus-visible` rule (`apps/extension/src/popup/components/modules/send/SelectTokenCard.vue:92-93`), so Tab shows only the browser's default outline, on the failed card's Retry too. It predates send-states; a designed ring is an owner call. From [send-states](send-states/plan.md).

- **A restored token with a receipt opens the first-receive prompt** (the owner's pick, 2026-09-30: "Trust restored tokens", its own small PR). `TokenService.restore` writes rows without the `onTokenAdded` emit that trusts an added token (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/token/service.ts:853-896`), and no backup slice carries trust (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/backup/backup-migration-registry.ts:195-216`), so each restored token with a receipt, a default seed included, asks again. Trust a restored token as an added one: no backup format change, and a Block on a listed token is not kept. From [amount-honesty](amount-honesty/plan.md), FU-4.

- **Six surfaces still read a token without a decimals getter in base units.** `apps/extension/src/popup/components/modules/general/RecentActivityView.vue:188` and `:373`, `apps/extension/src/popup/pages/journal/[id].vue:79`, `apps/extension/src/utils/journal-state.ts:381`, `apps/extension/src/composables/usePrices.ts:83` and `apps/extension/src/utils/token-fold.ts:21` format with `decimals || 0` or `?? 0`, and Home, Holdings and the incoming row read `isValidDecimals` without `hasDecimals`. Reached today only through the internal RPC; move each to `knownDecimals` when it is next touched. From [amount-honesty](amount-honesty/plan.md), FU-1.

- **A mint outside the standard shapes shows no amount.** Recording each call's amount parameter from the artifact the builder already resolves (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/execution/tx-request-builder.ts:186`, `:195`) would give it one; only if a real dApp's mint shows none. From [amount-honesty](amount-honesty/plan.md), FU-2.

- **A listed token's mint figure rests on its method's name and arity.** A pin on each added token's class, as the default seeds carry (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/token/default-tokens.ts`), would rest it on the implementation instead; a new feature, for its own plan. From [amount-honesty](amount-honesty/plan.md), FU-3.

- **An unlisted token's mint shows no amount** (the owner's O1 answer, 2026-09-30: "Look it up (own plan)"). Its decimals and symbol are a public call simulated on the node with this account as its sender (`apps/extension/src/wallet/services/execution/helpers/batched-view-simulation.ts:551-572`), so the node learns that this account looked at that contract; it needs the dApp's artifact in the PXE, a per-network and per-contract cache, and a failure state. From [amount-honesty](amount-honesty/plan.md), FU-5.

- **The authwit popups keep the 60 s ceiling.** `revokeAuthwits` and `setRegistryEnabled` await a full proof through `AuthRegistryServiceClient`, which sets no per-method timeout (`apps/extension/src/popup/components/popups/RevokeAuthwitsPopup.vue:103`, `ChangeAuthwitsRegistryPopup.vue:59`), so on Firefox without Presto they report a failure the background does not have. `ExecutionServiceClient`'s `getRequestTimeoutMs` override is the fix; what the popups show while they wait is an owner call. From [failed-send-check](failed-send-check/plan.md), F-1.

- **A definitive "won't go through".** DROPPED cannot prove a send never reached the network, so a send the check cannot confirm ends "Unconfirmed". An Aztec tx carries an expiry after which no block includes it; a check that knows it and the chain's time could say "won't go through, you can send it again". Unverified: the field's name and shape at Aztec 5.2.0. From [failed-send-check](failed-send-check/plan.md), F-2.
